hero.eyebrow: TCI AI Research · built on ThaiJO
hero.leadEn: Built by the TCI research team on ThaiJO data, with citations you can verify in every answer.
hero.body: AI tools from the TCI research team, connected directly to ThaiJO and international scholarly databases. They help authors search the literature, get answers to research questions and cite sources faster, and help editors screen manuscripts and find reviewers more accurately. Every answer can be traced back to its source.

tools.title: Designed around how Thai researchers really work
tools.lead: Built for how Thai research actually gets done. Every tool runs on ThaiJO data covering more than {articlesApprox} articles from {journals} journals, supplemented by international databases, and returns results with verifiable citations.

proposed.title: Future tools
proposed.lead: Gaps in the Thai journal workflow we propose to close next. Most of them sit in editorial work and in the steps before submission, and the research team proposes to develop tools for them in the next phase.

architecture.title: One agent, connected to all Thai journal data
architecture.lead: An open, layered stack. Users work in the Agentic Workspace; the AI Agent Orchestrator plans and selects the Skills that fit each question, then retrieves data through the TCI MCP Gateway & Registry (Model Context Protocol), the single connection point for MCP servers, Skills and APIs, both those available today and those added in future. All data passes through a pipeline designed for the Thai language before it is indexed, and every access follows the user's permissions in ThaiJO.
